/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd

file='national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Load lookup
lookup_df = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)
# header row at index 3
lookup_header = lookup_df.iloc[3].tolist()
lookup_data = lookup_df.iloc[4:].reset_index(drop=True)
lookup_data.columns = lookup_header
# Clean columns
lookup_data = lookup_data[['Cost Centre Code','District']].copy()
lookup_data['Cost Centre Code'] = lookup_data['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
lookup_data = lookup_data.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre Code'])
# Build mapping
cost_to_district = dict(zip(lookup_data['Cost Centre Code'], lookup_data['District'].astype(str).str.strip()))

# Field Expenses
fe_df = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
fe_header = fe_df.iloc[4].tolist()
fe_data = fe_df.iloc[5:].reset_index(drop=True)
fe_data.columns = fe_header
# Ensure columns exist
# Columns: Transaction ID, Transaction Date, Cost Centre, Expense Head, Vendor / Payee, Amount (INR), Posting Status
fe_data = fe_data.rename(columns={fe_header[2]:'Cost Centre', fe_header[6]:'Posting Status'})
fe_data['Cost Centre_norm'] = fe_data['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe_data['Posting Status_norm'] = fe_data['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
eligible_fe = fe_data[
    (fe_data['Posting Status_norm']=='posted') &
    (fe_data['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(cost_to_district))
].copy()
eligible_fe['District'] = eligible_fe['Cost Centre_norm'].map(cost_to_district)
count_fe = (eligible_fe['District'].str.strip().str.lower()=='barmer').sum()
print('Field eligible total', len(eligible_fe))
print('Field Barmer count', count_fe)

# Salary Register
sal_df = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
sal_header = sal_df.iloc[5].tolist()
sal_data = sal_df.iloc[6:].reset_index(drop=True)
sal_data.columns = sal_header
# Columns: Payroll Line ID, Pay Month, Employee ID, Role, Cost Centre, Gross Salary (INR), Payroll Status
sal_data = sal_data.rename(columns={sal_header[4]:'Cost Centre', sal_header[6]:'Payroll Status'})
sal_data['Cost Centre_norm'] = sal_data['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sal_data['Payroll Status_norm'] = sal_data['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
eligible_sal = sal_data[
    (sal_data['Payroll Status_norm']=='paid') &
    (sal_data['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(cost_to_district))
].copy()
eligible_sal['District'] = eligible_sal['Cost Centre_norm'].map(cost_to_district)
count_sal = (eligible_sal['District'].str.strip().str.lower()=='barmer').sum()
print('Salary eligible total', len(eligible_sal))
print('Salary Barmer count', count_sal)

print('Total Barmer', count_fe + count_sal)
\"
"
